dependency_edges.handoff: The accelerated cell state receives generated arrival types and initial conditions.
Generated human vehicles enter the human following rule.
Generated self-driving vehicles behind humans enter sensed feedback control.
Adjacent self-driving vehicles enter the cooperative communication rule.
Human safe gaps feed lane-change safety.
Mixed-follower safe gaps feed lane-change safety.
Cooperative safe gaps feed lane-change safety.
Lane states and vehicle attributes feed cloverleaf transfers.
Cell trajectories supply passing-time and density criteria.
Arrival volume and autonomous share define simulation scenarios.
Intersection transfers feed the road/intersection comparisons.
Sensitivity and error results identify state/transition repairs for future runs.
